headline: Two Chicago lawsuits accuse delivery-robot companies Coco and Serve Robotics of collecting people's face and hand data without consent, which both firms deny.
score_reason: Privacy allegations in court that both companies reject; the outcome is unknown.
importance_line: Chicago customers and passers-by on sidewalks are affected if robots collect personal scans, but these are unproven allegations and both companies say they do not identify people.
summary: ABC7 Chicago reports that two lawsuits filed in Cook County claim that Coco Robotics and Serve Robotics delivery robots scan the faces, hands and bodies of customers and passers-by without consent. Serve says it does not use the data to identify people, and Coco says it has not collected biometric data in Chicago and calls the claims meritless.
